title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether the Liquidation of a Sole Proprietorship Enterprise May Apply Mutatis Mutandis the Bankruptcy Liquidation Procedures under the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law

articles.content_en:
December 11, 2012
Supreme People's Court
Reply on Whether the Liquidation of a Sole Proprietorship Enterprise May Refer to and Apply the Bankruptcy Liquidation Procedures Provided in the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law
Fa Shi [2012] No. 16
Higher People's Court of Guizhou Province:
Your Request for Instructions on Whether the Liquidation of a Sole Proprietorship Enterprise May Refer to and Apply the Bankruptcy Liquidation Procedures (Qian Gao Yan Qing Zi No. 2 [2012]) has been received. Upon research, the reply is as follows:
Pursuant to Article 135 of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the People's Republic of China, where a sole proprietorship enterprise is unable to discharge its due debts and its assets are insufficient to pay all debts or it is obviously lacking in solvency, the bankruptcy liquidation procedures provided in the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law may be applied by reference for its liquidation.
Pursuant to Article 31 of the Sole Proprietorship Enterprise Law of the People's Republic of China, after a People's Court renders an order to conclude the liquidation procedures of a sole proprietorship enterprise by applying the bankruptcy liquidation procedures by reference, the creditors of the sole proprietorship enterprise may still assert claims against the investor for the portion that has not been satisfied.
